kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God … rightly dividing the word of truth
mine: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved … rightly handling the word of truth
note: spoudazo is to make every effort, not to study; the KJV verse is widely quoted to encourage Bible study. "Orthotomeo" (cut straight) means to handle correctly, and "dividing" has been taken as a warrant for schemes that divide Scripture into eras (dispensationalism).

kjv: their word will eat as doth a canker
mine: their talk will spread like gangrene
note: gangraina is gangrene; "canker" (ulcer) is close but obscure.
